mutations.name: the rollup never writes session_cost
kills: session_cost matches the request_cost sums for every session after a rollup

mutations.name: a delta pass clears every session's row
mutations.find: "DELETE FROM session_cost WHERE session_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(@sessionIds))"
kills: session_cost leaves another session's row unchanged when a delta pass touches one session

mutations.name: fan-out copies of a request are all counted
kills: session_cost counts a request copied across two transcripts once

mutations.name: unpriced requests are never counted
kills: session_cost counts a request without a price as unpriced at zero cost

mutations.name: replacing the price table leaves session_cost stale
kills: session_cost re-derives every row when the price table is replaced
